ScanSkinAI is an AI skin scanner that lets you upload a photograph and receive preliminary AI-supported information about possible skin-condition categories. Using models trained on large public and licensed dermatology image datasets, it analyses visible features in photos of moles, rashes, acne and other skin concerns and suggests possible visual matches. The result is not a diagnosis.

Across ScanSkinAI's medical image-analysis modules the platform covers more than 80 potential skin-condition categories — including melanoma, eczema, psoriasis, fungal infections and acne. The tool provides preliminary suggestions, confidence indications and next-step guidance ranging from monitoring at home to dermatologist referral. It does not confirm or exclude a diagnosis.

For a full-photo screen of any visible skin concern, start with our free AI skin analyzer.

Worried the lesion could be cancerous rather than inflammatory? Run a free skin cancer check online — it applies the ABCDE method to moles, sores that won't heal, crusty patches and pearly bumps, and flags visible signs associated with melanoma, basal cell carcinoma and squamous cell carcinoma.

## What Is AI Skin Illness Scanning

AI skin-image analysis uses models trained on large dermatology image datasets to evaluate visible features in a photo. By uploading a photo of your skin, mole, rash or lesion, you receive preliminary AI-supported suggestions in around 30 seconds. The result helps you decide whether and how quickly to seek professional care — it is a preliminary screening aid, not a diagnostic test, and cannot rule out serious disease.

## Skin Conditions That Can Be Detected

ScanSkinAI's powerful AI is designed to recognize over 80 common and serious skin conditions, spanning cancerous, inflammatory, infectious, and benign categories. Some of the key detectable conditions include:

### Skin Cancers

Melanoma, basal cell carcinoma, and squamous cell carcinoma

### Inflammatory

Eczema (atopic dermatitis), psoriasis, and rosacea

### Infections

Fungal infections, bacterial infections, and viral warts

### Common Concerns

Acne, seborrheic keratosis, actinic keratosis, and alopecia areata

This comprehensive detection capability ensures early identification of potential issues, allowing for timely professional consultation when needed.

## When to See a Doctor

Seek urgent care if you experience these symptoms.

- Rapidly spreading redness with fever
- Difficulty breathing or facial swelling
- Severe burns or uncontrolled bleeding
- Widespread blistering or skin peeling
- Purple spots with neck stiffness
- Signs of infection (pus, red streaks)

This tool is not a substitute for professional medical advice. Contact emergency services for urgent symptoms.

## Why one check is rarely enough

A single scan tells you about one spot, on one day. But skin changes are about patterns over time — a new mole appearing, a slow shift in shape, size or colour, or a patch that simply isn't healing. Monitoring the same spots side-by-side, week after week, surfaces the subtle changes a one-off check will always miss — and gives you a clear record to show a clinician if something needs a closer look.

(ScanSkinAI is a screening and monitoring tool, not a diagnosis. Always see a clinician for anything that is changing, bleeding, or worrying you.)
